description: When arrow-binding functionality is disabled in the editor, the snap-to-midpoint menu item should also be disabled to maintain consistency in the user interface. This ensures users don't see enabled options that won't work as expected due to the current configuration.
functional_requirements: Disable the snap-to-midpoint menu item in the main menu when arrow-binding is turned off
Maintain the menu item's disabled state consistently across all relevant UI components
Ensure the menu item remains visible but non-interactive when disabled
